input: Find outdoor adventure, nature, farm, horseback riding and sports summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Sylva, Dillsboro, Cullowhee, Cashiers, Cherokee and Bryson City, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Sylva Cullowhee summer camps 2026 outdoor sports kids
Nantahala Outdoor Center youth paddling summer 2026

candidates.name: Western Carolina University
candidates.note: Lil’ Cats recreation camp and multiple athletics camps; the university lists summer 2026 programming.

candidates.name: P.R. Running Camp
candidates.note: Middle- and high-school running camps at WCU, with trail training and tubing; July 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Jackson County Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: Summer day camp for ages 6–12 includes games, swimming and field trips; also offers summer youth tennis lessons.

candidates.name: Nantahala Outdoor Center
candidates.note: Youth summer paddling instruction on WNC rivers, with beginner through advanced whitewater kayaking programs.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Operates YMCA Camp Watia, an outdoor overnight camp documented operating in summer 2026.

candidates.name: Camp Living Water
candidates.note: July youth camps for ages 7–12 and 13–17 include tubing, hiking, rafting and horseback riding.

candidates.name: Adventure Amputee Camp
candidates.note: Five-day July camp for ages 8–17 with limb differences, based at Nantahala Outdoor Center.

candidates.name: SOAR
candidates.note: Outdoor adventure summer camps for children and teens with ADHD and learning differences, based in Balsam.

candidates.name: Cedar Creek Club
candidates.note: Eight weeks of summer kids camp with outdoor activities, nature discovery and crafts; junior racquet-sport instruction also offered.

candidates.name: Trillium Links and Lake Club
candidates.note: Camp Trillium summer programming includes golf, tennis, swimming, hiking, rafting, horseback riding and lake activities.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of the Plateau
candidates.note: Summer camp programming for kindergarten through grade 12 at its Cashiers club, including healthy-lifestyle activities.

candidates.name: Cherokee Youth Center
candidates.note: Supervised summer youth program for ages 5–18 or grades K–12; specific outdoor and sports activities need confirmation.
